arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, analyze the seeded daily price series versus the fixed SPY benchmark and XLK/XLC sector benchmarks for 21/63-session technical context: returns, trend, drawdown/volatility and relative performance where supported. Identify any data-date or indicator limitations. Separate observed calculations from conditional interpretation; do not make an investment conclusion. Stop after the provided series supports the requested horizon context.
arguments.decision_impact: Provides common market/sector-relative technical context and identifies whether short-horizon theses depend on price trend or elevated volatility.
